dct_description_sm: 3 bar scales on map, given in "Iusta Miliaria Flandrica itineris unius horae" (13 units [=16.1 cm]), “Miliaria mains cula,” and “Miliaria magna."
Decorative cartouche, elaborate compass rose, shields (including Hapsburg), ships.
Pictorial vignette of figures in mid-left.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 252.
